office_does: The sheriff runs the county's patrol, investigations, 911 dispatch, jail and emergency management.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Sheriff John Mason (States No Party Preference), appointed in 2024 and elected in 2025, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Wahkiakum County Sheriff since a July 2024 appointment, elected in 2025; with the Sheriff's Office since 2013.
highlights: Appointed sheriff in July 2024 on Mark Howie's retirement [S5]
Won the 2025 election with 87.44% of the vote [S7]
Says he keeps "a conservative budget within our current means" and promotes officer wellness [S4]
